headline: Direct OAuth integration for external Zoho CRM users is free, instant, and requires no mandatory app review.
summary: Developers can create a Server-based Application in the Zoho API Console to instantly authorize external users. Multi-tenant access works by default, but developers must explicitly toggle Multi DC Support to accept users across Zoho's international data centers. A formal app review is strictly optional and only required if listing in the Zoho Marketplace.

oauth.refresh_tokens: Include access_type=offline and prompt=consent in the authorization request. Tokens never expire but are limited to 20 per user per app.
oauth.redirect_uri_rules: Strict exact match required. Must use HTTPS (except HTTP for local development). Multiple URIs are supported.

steps.title: Create Server-based Application
steps.detail: Log into the Zoho API Console and create a Server-based Application to support external Multi-tenant users.

steps.title: Enable Multi DC Support
steps.detail: Explicitly toggle Multi DC Support in the client settings to accept international users and generate region-specific Client Secrets.

steps.title: Document Required Scopes
steps.detail: Identify the exact Zoho CRM scopes required for the AI agent (e.g., ZohoCRM.modules.ALL).

steps.title: Implement Multi-DC OAuth Flow
steps.detail: Write logic to dynamically target the correct accounts domain (e.g., accounts.zoho.com vs accounts.zoho.eu) based on the user's location and supply the matching regional Client Secret.

steps.title: Implement Fast Token Exchange
steps.detail: Ensure the application exchanges the authorization grant code for an access token within the strict 2-minute expiration window.

requirements.text: Multi DC Support must be manually toggled in the API Console to accept users from non-home data centers (EU, IN, AU, JP, CA, CN).
The target Zoho CRM organization must be on a paid edition or an active developer/sandbox plan to access the API.
Direct integrations for external users do not require mandatory app review or security audits.

gotchas.text: Authorization grant codes expire in exactly 2 minutes.
Zoho enforces a hard limit of 20 active refresh tokens per user per app. Creating a 21st token automatically revokes the oldest one without warning.
Attempting to use a client secret or authorization code from a different data center region will result in invalid_client or invalid_code errors.

permissions.action: Read and write standard and custom CRM records (Leads, Contacts, Deals).
permissions.review_impact: Requires user to have assigned profile permissions and the organization to be on a paid plan. No extra review required.

permissions.action: Read CRM configuration, custom fields, and layout metadata.
Read organization user identity and profiles.
Modify organizational settings or restricted administrative configurations.
permissions.review_impact: Requires the authenticating user to hold an Administrator role to grant consent.

blockers.issue: Encountering invalid_client or invalid_code during token exchange.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Verify the authenticating user's Data Center (provided in the location callback parameter) and ensure the application targets the matching regional Accounts URL and region-specific Client Secret.

blockers.issue: Refresh tokens inexplicably stop working for users who log in frequently.
blockers.how_to_proceed: You have likely hit the 20 refresh token limit per user. Store refresh tokens securely per user ID and reuse them rather than requesting a new refresh token on every login.

agent_can: Determine required OAuth scopes based on the planned API operations.
Implement logic to parse the 'location' callback parameter and route token requests to the correct regional data center endpoint.
Implement token lifecycle management to stay under the 20 active refresh tokens limit.
Ensure authorization codes are exchanged within the strict 2-minute validity window.
you_must: Register a Server-based Application in the Zoho API Console.
Explicitly toggle 'Multi DC Support' in the application settings.
Add authorized redirect URIs to the application profile.

key_claims.text: Direct OAuth integration for SaaS platforms is free, immediate, and skips mandatory review.
The authorization endpoint accounts.zoho.com/oauth/v2/auth is live and actively redirects to the Zoho sign-in service.
The developer API console requires authentication and is hosted at api-console.zoho.com.
Zoho supports PKCE with the S256 method.
Multi DC Support requires explicit manual toggling by the developer in the console.
